title: МЕРИДИАН
subtitle: Литературен журнал
manifesto: Meridian exists at the crossing-point. We are a literary journal, yes — but also a cartographic project, an attempt to chart the territories where language touches what language cannot say. Each issue is organized around a single word drawn from theology, philosophy, or ancient science, that serves as both compass and constraint. We publish fiction that reads like marginalia, poetry that functions as cartography, essays that dissolve into prayer. We are interested in the liminal, the apophatic, the palimpsestic — in language that knows its own limits and presses against them. The name refers to the astronomical meridian — the imaginary line that divides the sky into eastern and western hemispheres. It is the line you cannot see, the division that makes orientation possible. Every act of reading is a crossing of some such line. We are edited in solitude and published at the turning of each season.
